page.overview:
Who is Junkyard Jr.?

Junkyard Jr. is Junkyard's offspring and sucessor as Mutt's dog in the G.I. Joe Team.

When Alpine, Bazooka, Mutt and Rock 'n Roll reunite at the Old Clyde's restaurant, Mutt leaves Junkyard Jr. tied outside as the place doesn't allow dogs. After the Joes have been captured by Cobra forces in the restaurant, one agent named "Phillip" goes after Junkyard Jr. to use him as a bargaining chip, but only finds a broken leash. It turns out that Junkyard Jr. has hidden in Rock 'n Roll's car, where Mutt and the others find him after they get free.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 2

The Tiger Force version of Mutt from the Dreadnok Rampage convention exclusive pack is, so far, the only version explicitly including Junkyard II instead of the original one. ----
